shortInfo: India Post has announced notification for Skilled Artisans/Tradesmen (MV Mechanic, MV Electrician, Tyreman, Blacksmith, Painter, Upholsterer, Carpenter & Joiner) posts. Required qualification: Certificate in respective trade or VIII Std. with experience, HMV Licence for MV Mechanic. Last date to apply: 30-11-26.

dates.event: Last Date for Receipt of Application

howToApply: Fill the application on plain paper in the prescribed format, completely and correctly, and sign it.
Affix one recent passport size photograph at the designated place on the application form and self-attest it.

Attach self-attested photocopies of: Age proof, Address proof, Indian Citizenship proof, Educational Qualification, Technical Qualification (ITI etc.), HMV Driving Licence/Licence Extract (for MV Mechanic only), One year trade experience certificate with full postal address of organization, SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/ESM Certificate issued by Competent Authority, and two self-attested passport size photographs.
Submit separate applications for each trade if applying for multiple trades.
Superscribe the trade applied for on the envelope.
Send the application through Speed Post only to: The Senior Manager, Mail Motor Services, 139, Beleghata Main Road, Kolkata-700015.
Ensure the application is received on or before 30/11/2026 by 17:00 Hours.
Do not send original certificates; send only self-attested copies.

shortInfo: IRCON has announced notification for Manager (Walk-in) posts. Required qualification: B.Tech/B.E. Last date to apply: 19,.
howToApply: Candidates should ensure they fulfill all eligibility criteria before reporting for Walk-in Interview.
Register at the respective venue as per the schedule (Registration starts at 09:30 AM, closes at 1:00 PM).

Bring one set of photocopies along with originals of: Application typed on A-4 size paper in the prescribed format, Experience Certificates in chronological order (with last two months’ salary slip for present employment), Date of Birth/Class X passing certificate, Caste/EWS/Age relaxation certificate (in prescribed GoI format), Qualification Degree/Diploma and all semester/year mark sheets.
OBC candidates must bring a caste certificate issued in the current financial year as proof of not belonging to the creamy layer.
Candidates with CGPA/OGPA/DGPA should bring a conversion certificate from their university/institute if applicable.
No request for change of date, time, or location will be entertained.
For queries, email: recruitment@ircon.org

title: LIC HFL Recruitment 2026 – Apprentice Posts
shortInfo: LIC HFL has announced notification for Apprentice posts. Required qualification: Graduation in any stream. Last date to apply: 01-11-26.

fees.category: General, EWS and Other Backward Class (OBC) - Male candidates
General, EWS and Other Backward Class (OBC) - Female / Transgender candidates

dates.event: Last Date to Apply & Pay Examination Fee

howToApply: Candidates must first mandatorily register themselves on the NATS portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) by navigating to the ‘Student Register/Login’ section.
After registration, candidates will receive an email from BFSI SSC inviting them to fill up a detailed application and make payment for the Online Examination for ‘LIC HFL Apprenticeship Program’.
Visit https://beep.bfsissc.com to submit additional information and make the examination fee payment before 01-Nov-2026.
Note your Enrolment ID issued by the NATS portal for all future correspondence.
All eligible applicants who have paid the examination fee will receive an online examination link and login credentials from BFSI SSC on the day before the examination date.
Appear for the online remote proctored examination on 07-Nov-2026 from home using a camera-enabled device with good internet connectivity.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited for Document Verification & Personal Interview at LIC HFL offices on 15-Nov-2026.
Final selected candidates will receive engagement letters from LIC HFL tentatively in the 3rd week of November.

howToApply: Visit the official website of Public Service Commission, West Bengal at https://psc.wb.gov.in
Find and click on the Advertisement No. 22/2024 for the post of Sub-Surveyor.
Register/Login to your individual account on the PSC website.

Fill in the online application form with all required details including Photo ID details (Madhyamik certificate, Passport, PAN card, EPIC/Voter ID, Driving License, Aadhaar card, or any other State/Central Govt. issued ID).
Upload required documents as specified.

Pay the application fee of Rs. 110/- (plus applicable service charges) through online mode only. SC/ST candidates of West Bengal and PwBD candidates (40% and above disability) are exempted from fee payment.
Submit the application form before the closing date (9th November 2026 up to 3 p.m.).
Take a printout of the submitted application form for future reference.
If required, use the Edit Window (11.11.2026 to 16.11.2026) to correct any details. This option can be availed only once.
